label: Moss forest world
desc: A procedural mossy forest glade with layered trunks, light shafts, a moss-capped root arch, swaying ferns and drifting pollen; the variant prop turns it into spring blossoms, autumn leaves or winter snow, and the pointer shifts the layers for parallax.
use: Behind a landing hero, an about page or a nature section (fills its parent, which should be positioned); pick `variant` by season.

label: Night temple scene
desc: A procedural night scene of a tiered pagoda and hall on a mountain under a moon, with layered ridges, drifting mist, rain, flickering lantern glow and ripples on wet ground (invented, generic forms).
use: Behind a hero, a 404 page or an atmospheric section (fills its parent, which should be positioned).

label: Landscape
desc: A procedural 3-D terrain rendered by a column-marching heightfield renderer, with sunrise, noon, sunset or night skies and clear, rain, storm (lightning), snow or fog weather; the pointer pans and tilts the camera.
use: Behind a hero, a weather or travel section (fills its parent, which should be positioned); set `time` and `weather`.

label: Landscape towers
desc: A dusk landscape where invented tower forms (tiered pagoda-like, minaret-like, stupa-like, lighthouse-like and stacked spire) build up from their foot; show one with `variant` or all five as an ensemble, mirrored in water.
use: Hero or section backdrop for travel, culture or architecture pages (fills its parent, which should be positioned).

label: Bookshelf 3D
desc: A room with a bookshelf whose books stand on a rotating ring: pick one to bring it to the front, then open it and turn its pages with a 3-D flip; covers are generated and keyboard and touch work.
use: Library, reading list, product or catalogue showcase (fills its parent; pass `books`).

label: Structure flow
desc: Six particle studies drawn as projected 3-D points in the host ink with accent tints: geodesic dome, horizon field, nested orbits, funnel vortex, data matrix and rising embers; the pointer turns the view.
use: Behind a hero or data/AI product section (fills its parent, which should be positioned); choose `variant`.

label: Warp field
desc: A warp tunnel of additive light streaks with keycap-like letter tiles flying past in perspective; the pointer steers the vanishing point.
use: Behind a launch or speed-themed hero, a typing or keyboard product section (fills its parent, which should be positioned).

label: Woven cloth
desc: A hanging cloth simulated with Verlet physics and wind, woven from procedural threads (plain, twill or basket) and printed with text; the pointer dents and drags the weave.
use: Textile, fashion or craft hero, or a banner section (fills its parent, which should be positioned); set `text` and `weave`.
